description:
Enable labels on the Natural Earth countries layer in gvSIG to display country names.

gvSIG is already open with a View containing the Natural Earth countries layer (ne_110m_admin_0_countries). Your task:

1. In the View's Table of Contents (layer panel), right-click on the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer.
2. Select 'Properties' (or 'Propiedades') from the context menu to open the Layer Properties dialog.
3. In the Layer Properties dialog, click on the 'Labels' tab (may be called 'Etiquetas' or 'Labeling').
4. Check the checkbox to enable labeling (something like 'Label this layer with' or 'Enable labels').
5. In the 'Label field' dropdown, select 'NAME' (the field containing country names like 'United States', 'Brazil', 'China', etc.).
6. Click 'OK' or 'Accept' to apply the changes.
7. The map should now show country names (text labels) overlaid on the country polygons.

The task is complete when country name labels are visible on the map, showing names like 'Brazil', 'Russia', 'Australia', etc.
